about: Attorney Kirk C. Davis is the founder and owner of the Law Office of Kirk C. Davis in Seattle, Washington. A nationally ranked trial lawyer with nearly 30 years of total legal experience, Mr. Davis provides exceptional counsel and support to clients across the state who have suffered an injury or loss as a result of someone else's negligent, careless or unlawful actions.

The leader of one of Puget Sound's most prominent personal injury practices, Mr. Davis has achieved remarkable success fighting on behalf of those adversely affected by motor vehicle accidents, unsafe property conditions and other preventable tragedies. He is also a staunch advocate for children who have suffered sexual abuse as well as the elderly who experience abuse or neglect in a nursing home.

From his efforts, Mr. Davis has recovered millions of dollars in total compensation for his plaintiff clients by helping to hold those responsible for his clients' suffering accountable for their actions. Honored for his outstanding professionalism and service, he was listed among the Top 100 Trial Lawyers by The National Trial Lawyers along with many other top rankings and endorsements from his peers. He has also received Superb, 10 out of 10 client ratings on Avvo as well as numerous testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients.

A 1988 graduate of Vassar College, Mr. Davis obtained his Juris Doctor from The George Washington University Law School in 1991. He began his legal career as a Special Deputy Prosecutor with the King County Prosecutor's Office and then as Deputy Prosecutor with the Yakima County Prosecutor's Office. He is an active member of the Washington State Bar Association, the National Crime Victim Bar Association, the American Bar Association and the Washington State Association for Justice, among his other professional affiliations.
